status: Validated for the stated static scope and one matched trial per arm; all material findings from three Claude consultation rounds and the CodeRabbit review accounted for. The Codex profile was skipped at its usage limit.
request: Stop stacked-pr from adding the bottom-to-top "Stack" line to PR bodies when the stack is native (gh-stack CLI or REST API), because GitHub already shows a native stack's order and navigation on every member PR; ordinary dependent-PR chains keep the map.
diagnosis: cli-create.md Submit and api-create.md Open PRs told the agent to add the same compact bottom-to-top map to every body and verified it at completion. The pr skill has no stack-map rule.

changes.change: Defines the stack map once: a PR in a native stack carries none and loses any map it brings into one; every other open PR in a dependent chain carries it, because GitHub shows no chain for it.
Submit, PR creation and extension produce and verify bodies without a stack map, including a reused PR appended to the top.

The gh stack link path removes maps from linked PRs and its criterion checks it. Migration to manual adds the map to every open PR that GitHub no longer stacks, in its own paragraph after the decision step that divergence handling borrows.
A requested dissolution, unlike the dissolve step inside a restructure, adds the map to every open PR that GitHub no longer stacks, and its criterion checks it.
Map steps in the manual operations write a map only on a PR that GitHub does not stack; a PR that a retained native stack still groups carries none.
"layer map" becomes "layer plan", the term the file already uses, so it no longer reads as the PR-body map.
Refreshed both stacked-pr entrypoint hashes, its checkedAt date and the catalog cache key.

findings.finding: Manual maintain and merge steps (update all maps, every remaining PR map) could write a map on a PR that a retained native stack still groups.
findings.disposition: Applied in one place: manual-chain.md limits the map steps of every manual operation, instead of qualifying each sentence in manual-maintain.md and manual-merge.md.

findings.finding: Migration that retains the native stack should remove maps from retained PRs and check it at completion.
findings.disposition: Not applied. No route writes a map on a native-stack PR and a PR adopted into one loses its map, so only a map that predates this change could remain; the retain branch leaves the PRs unchanged by design, and the proposed criterion would require body edits outside the migration.
